song.title: Nomadic Hustla (Trap Glitch Overdrive)
song.description: Nomad with a pack, demon in the night. Dark trap with sub-crushing 808s, ominous bells and glitch-saturated breakdowns. MusicSubject × Call Me Daddy.

lyrics.text:
[Verse 1]
Nomad with a pack, I’m a hustla, hustla
Chrome tuck in the back, I’m a hustla, hustla
City glare on the glass, I’m a husss, husss
Every step that I take, I be huss-sa-ling, I move

[Chorus]
Hustla, hustla, demon in the night (hustla)
Husss, husss, huntin’ for the price (husss)
Huss-sa-ling I be, hus-saha (heheheheh)
All around the trap, I’m a hustla for life

[Verse 2]
From the block to the hills, I’m a hustla, hustla
Turn a dream to a bill, I’m a hustla, hustla
Got the bass in my wheels, I’m a husss, husss
In the smoke, on the run, I be huss-sa-ling through

[Chorus]
Hustla, hustla, demon in the night (hustla)
Husss, husss, huntin’ for the price (husss)
Huss-sa-ling I be, hus-saha (heheheheh)
All around the trap, I’m a hustla for life

[Bridge]
Yeah I roam with a nine, I’m a hustla, hustla
Every code, every sign, I’m a hustla, hustla
Hear the click in the time, just a husss, husss
On the wind, in the bass, I be huss-sa-ling too

[Chorus]
Hustla, hustla, demon in the night (hustla)
Husss, husss, huntin’ for the price (husss)
Huss-sa-ling I be, hus-saha (heheheheh)
All around the trap, I’m a hustla for life
